recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-18049 unless maintainers separately decide to clean archived removed-resource source that is outside the current build.
issue_request: FHIR-18049 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked the Clinical Reasoning module to stop linking to cds-hooks.org now that cds-hooks.hl7.org exists.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to GH#:8e303bd11b. That commit updated the active Clinical Reasoning module audience text from https://cds-hooks.org/ to https://cds-hooks.hl7.org/, matching the requested host correction.
additional_context: Current source shows clinicalreasoning-cds-on-fhir.html is an active page in publish.ini and links CDS Hooks to http://cds-hooks.hl7.org. A full source grep found the old host only in source/servicedefinition/servicedefinition-introduction.xml; source/fhir.ini lists ServiceDefinition under [removed-resources], and GF#13410 removed it from the active resource list before FHIR-18049 was applied. Later Applied issues FHIR-53084 and FHIR-53085 revised the same Clinical Reasoning topic family for R6 and did not restore the old host.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build already satisfies the Jira request and editing removed ServiceDefinition source would not correct current FHIR output.
